extra.message: User-controlled input from the `username` query parameter is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string passed to `Jinja2.from_string()`. This allows Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI), enabling attackers to execute arbitrary Python code on the server.

User input from the `username` parameter is embedded into an HTML response without sanitization or escaping. Since the input is concatenated into a Jinja2 template as literal text and returned via `HTMLResponse`, malicious scripts (e.g., `<script>alert(1)</script>`) will execute in the victim's browser.
